description: Explain one metric before using its numbers: what it shows, how to read it, caveats, formula, payload fields with units, input data categories, update cadence, known limitations and freshness (last data day, published_at, granularities), plus the page URL, the REST endpoint and a ready citation string. Call it when the user asks what a metric means or before interpreting get_chart output.
name: describe_chart
title: Describe a chart
